title: LangGraph — Agents as Stateful Graphs
desc: Modelling an agent as nodes, edges and shared state, and why explicit graphs make control flow inspectable.
objectives: Describe nodes, edges and shared state.
Explain why explicit control flow helps debugging.
objectivesKn: ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಹರಿವು debugging ಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

title: LangGraph — Persistence, Checkpoints and Durable Execution
desc: How saving state after each step lets an agent resume after failure, pause for humans and travel back in time.
objectives: Explain checkpoints and what they store.
Explain replay and forking from a past checkpoint.
objectivesKn: checkpoints ಮತ್ತು ಅವು ಏನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
ಹಿಂದಿನ checkpoint ನಿಂದ replay ಮತ್ತು fork ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

[{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"LangGraph — Persistence, Checkpoints and Durable Execution","textKn":"LangGraph — Persistence, Checkpoints and Durable Execution","level":"H1"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Lesson Info","headingKn":"Lesson ಮಾಹಿತಿ","bodyEn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 minutes · Part 2 of 3 in LangGraph: Stateful Graphs and Durable Execution","bodyKn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳು · Part 2 of 3"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Checkpoint After Every Step","headingKn":"ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಂತದ ನಂತರ Checkpoint","bodyEn":"After each node the framework can save the whole state under a thread id. If the process crashes, execution restarts from the last checkpoint instead of from the beginning.","bodyKn":"ಪ್ರತಿ node ನಂತರ ಚೌಕಟ್ಟು ಇಡೀ state ಅನ್ನು thread id ಅಡಿ ಉಳಿಸಬಹುದು. ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಶ್ ಆದರೆ ಕೊನೆಯ checkpoint ನಿಂದ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Human-in-the-Loop Pauses","headingKn":"ಮಾನವ-ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ವಿರಾಮ","bodyEn":"A graph can stop before a risky node, wait for a person to approve or edit the state, and then resume. Because state was saved, the wait can last minutes or days.","bodyKn":"ಅಪಾಯಕಾರಿ node ಮೊದಲು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ, ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಅನುಮೋದಿಸುವವರೆಗೆ ಕಾಯಿ, state ತಿದ್ದಿ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಬಹುದು. state ಉಳಿದಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಕಾಯುವಿಕೆ ನಿಮಿಷ ಅಥವಾ ದಿನಗಳಾಗಬಹುದು."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Replay and Forking","headingKn":"Replay ಮತ್ತು Forking","bodyEn":"Past checkpoints can be re-run or forked with a changed state, which is useful for debugging a bad decision or trying an alternative without redoing earlier work.","bodyKn":"ಹಿಂದಿನ checkpoints ಮರುಚಾಲನೆ ಅಥವಾ ಬದಲಾದ state ಜೊತೆ fork ಮಾಡಬಹುದು; ಕೆಟ್ಟ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ debug ಮಾಡಲು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Durability Has Requirements","headingKn":"Durability ಗೆ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳು","bodyEn":"State must be serialisable, and side-effecting nodes must be safe to re-run or protected by idempotency keys, because a resumed step may execute twice.","bodyKn":"state serialise ಆಗಬೇಕು; side-effect nodes ಮರುಚಾಲನೆಗೆ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಅಥವಾ idempotency keys ನಿಂದ ರಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಮುಂದುವರಿದ ಹಂತ ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಚಲಿಸಬಹುದು."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Key Takeaways","headingKn":"ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳು","bodyEn":"• Checkpoints let runs resume after failure.
• Pauses enable human approval.
• Re-runnable steps need idempotency.","bodyKn":"• checkpoints ವೈಫಲ್ಯದ ನಂತರ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು.
• ವಿರಾಮ ಮಾನವ ಅನುಮೋದನೆಗೆ.
• ಮರುಚಾಲನೆಗೆ idempotency."}},{"type":"quiz","data":{"questions":[{"q":"What does a checkpoint enable?","qKn":"checkpoint ಏನು ಸಾಧ್ಯಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?","opts":["Resuming from the last saved step","Faster models","Smaller vocabularies","Free compute"],"optsKn":["ಕೊನೆಯ ಉಳಿಸಿದ ಹಂತದಿಂದ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುವುದು","ವೇಗದ ಮಾದರಿ","ಚಿಕ್ಕ vocabulary","ಉಚಿತ ಗಣನೆ"],"correct":0},{"q":"Why can a resumed step run twice?","qKn":"ಮುಂದುವರಿದ ಹಂತ ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಏಕೆ ಚಲಿಸಬಹುದು?","opts":["It may have partly executed before the crash","Graphs always repeat","Users click twice","Checkpoints duplicate"],"optsKn":["ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಶ್ ಮೊದಲು ಭಾಗಶಃ ಚಲಿಸಿರಬಹುದು","graphs ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತವೆ","ಬಳಕೆದಾರ ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಕ್ಲಿಕ್","checkpoints ನಕಲು"],"correct":0},{"q":"What is forking a checkpoint good for?","qKn":"checkpoint fork ಯಾವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಉತ್ತಮ?","opts":["Trying an alternative without redoing earlier work","Deleting history","Encrypting state","Nothing"],"optsKn":["ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕೆಲಸ ಮರುಮಾಡದೆ ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ","ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಅಳಿಸುವುದು","state ಎನ್‌ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಟ್","ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ"],"correct":0}]}}]
